race.comment: PERCIDIAN (7) returns off a five-week freshening with the strongest recent form, having won a BM64 at Morphettville by a neck after travelling well and covering ground. His start-prior fifth in a BM68 had interference attached, and his record at this track, plus Rochelle Milnes having two wins aboard him, gives him a very solid platform. HAMNER SPRINGS (8) is the main danger after winning at this track by a length and a half despite racing wide throughout, and his track-and-distance record reads well for this. MR RIBTICKLER (6) was below his best when fifth behind HAMNER SPRINGS, but the prior three-length Mdn win at this venue was decisive and keeps him firmly in the mix. SHOGUN CHIKARA (3) is lightly raced, unbeaten out of the quinella, and was strong as an odds-on Mdn winner at Morphettville. The new 1719m trip is the key question but can contest.
